spans.s: चिह्न n. 1. Mark, spot, stamp, badge, R.i.44, iii.55; 2. sign, indication, प्रसादचिह्नानि पुरःफलानि R.ii.22; 3. a sign of the zodiac; 4. aim, direction.
चिह्न-कारिन् a. 1. marking, spotting; 2. wounding, killing; 3. frightful, hideous.
चिह्नित a. (f. ता) 1. Marked, bearing the insignia of an office, चिह्निता राजशासनैः M.x.55; 2. known; 3. branded.
चिह्नित a. (f. ता) 1. Marked, bearing the insignia of an office, चिह्निता राजशासनैः M.x.55; 2. known; 3. branded.
